reviewer.agent: Claude Code (file handoff; environment names the handoff channel)

themes.label: Military AI challenging arms control
themes.definition: AI in the military domain and autonomous weapons presented as new challenges for arms control and international regulation.
themes.inclusion: Include passages explicitly naming military AI or autonomous weapons as arms-control or security challenges.
themes.exclusion: Exclude passages where AI is only named in a list of rivalries without military specification (AI_THREAT_LIST_MENTION).
themes.boundary_cases: 'Rivalry in artificial intelligence' as part of an arms race narrative is borderline; code here only if military use is explicit.

examples.quote: the proliferation of advanced technologies, such as artificial intelligence in the military domain and autonomous weapons systems, has introduced new challenges for arms control and international regulations

themes.label: AI listed among global threats
themes.definition: AI is named briefly within a list of security threats, rivalries or drivers of global crisis, without elaboration.
themes.inclusion: Include passages where AI appears as one item in a catalogue of threats, crises or rivalries.
themes.exclusion: Exclude neutral or positive technology lists (AI_TECH_LIST_MENTION) and passages with substantive AI discussion.
themes.boundary_cases: A list item with an evaluative adjective (e.g. 'uncontrollable') remains a list mention unless the speaker develops the point.

examples.quote: an intense rivalry in space, cybertechnology and artificial intelligence
the seemingly uncontrollable chariots of artificial intelligence

themes.label: AI as arena of strategic rivalry
themes.definition: AI framed as a domain of geopolitical rivalry contributing to erosion of trust and a renewed arms race.
themes.inclusion: Include passages describing competition or rivalry among powers over AI as a security problem.
themes.boundary_cases: If rivalry is only listed without link to security, code AI_THREAT_LIST_MENTION alone.

examples.quote: Those challenges are aggravated by restrictive sanctions, trade wars, an intense rivalry in space, cybertechnology and artificial intelligence.

value.rationale: All three passages place AI within security-threat framings. Kenya is the only one to specify military AI and autonomous weapons; Kazakhstan and Saint Vincent list AI briefly as a rivalry domain or uncontrolled threat among many.
